title: Meridian
text: "You will want to know my name. You have it already. You have had it all along, folded up under your own."

lines.text: "I am not asking you to agree. None of the others agreed. I am asking you to finish."

choices.label: "I'm not you."
choices.reply: "No. You are what I was before I knew better. I remember being sure of that, too."

choices.label: "What happened to the others?"
choices.reply: "They finished. Then they became me. There is room."

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.reply: It waits, politely, as you would.

notes: The Clause wakes. Starts after the Foundry, once lead ≥ 6 (Foundry +3, Ledger +2, one report a sol). Plays cine-meridian; the card follows it.
